newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-SIMONE HAT-TRICK GIVES MILAN EURO BOOST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SIMONE HAT-TRICK GIVES MILAN EURO BOOST.

text.p: A hat-trick from Marco Simone and another goal from majestic Liberian George Weah gave AC Milan a thumping 4-1 victory over hapless Norwegians Rosenborg Trondheim in the European Cup on Wednesday.
Simone's three goals in the first 25 minutes sunk the Norwegians, whose defence played as though paralysed against the Italian onslaught throughout the Champions' League Group D match.

Trond Egil Soltvedt equalised for Rosenborg in the 16th minute but Simone -- his white boots flashing in the frosty night air of central Norway -- slotted home an arrogant side foot in the 23rd minute and a cool far-post header in the 25th to seal the match.

Weah, gliding effortlessly through the static Norwegian defence, was presented with a sharp-angled chance by the 27-year-old Simone in the 55th minute, slotting the ball home to put the Italians 4-1 up.
By the end of the evening, Rosenborg could count themselves lucky not to have been on the end of a nine-goal pasting, as their coach Nils Arne Eggen predicted they could be earlier this week.
